extends Node

signal health_changed(old_value: int, new_value: int)
signal died

var health: int = 100


func take_damage(amount: int) -> void:
	if health <= 0 or amount <= 0:
		return
	var old_value := health
	health = maxi(health - amount, 0)
	health_changed.emit(old_value, health)
	if health == 0:
		died.emit()

extends Node2D

signal faded

var _tween: Tween


func fade_out(duration: float) -> void:
	if _tween and _tween.is_valid():
		_tween.kill()
	modulate.a = 1.0
	_tween = create_tween()
	_tween.tween_property(self, "modulate:a", 0.0, duration)
	_tween.finished.connect(_on_tween_finished)


func _on_tween_finished() -> void:
	faded.emit()

first.code:
extends Node

const MAX_CHILDREN := 4

var spawned_count := 0

var _timer: Timer


func _ready() -> void:
	_timer = Timer.new()
	_timer.wait_time = 0.25
	_timer.one_shot = false
	_timer.timeout.connect(_on_timer_timeout)
	add_child(_timer)
	_timer.start()


func _on_timer_timeout() -> void:
	if spawned_count >= MAX_CHILDREN:
		_timer.stop()
		return
	add_child(Node2D.new())
	spawned_count += 1
	if spawned_count >= MAX_CHILDREN:
		_timer.stop()

extends Node2D


func _enter_tree() -> void:
	var player := AnimationPlayer.new()
	player.name = "AnimationPlayer"
	add_child(player)

	var anim := Animation.new()
	anim.length = 1.0
	anim.loop_mode = Animation.LOOP_LINEAR

	var track := anim.add_track(Animation.TYPE_VALUE)
	anim.track_set_path(track, NodePath(".:visible"))
	anim.track_set_interpolation_type(track, Animation.INTERPOLATION_NEAREST)
	anim.value_track_set_update_mode(track, Animation.UPDATE_DISCRETE)
	anim.track_insert_key(track, 0.0, true)
	anim.track_insert_key(track, 0.5, false)

	var library := AnimationLibrary.new()
	library.add_animation("blink", anim)
	player.add_animation_library("", library)

	player.play("blink")
